blocks.text: Degenerative bimariyan woh halatein hain jin mein dimagh, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke nerve cells ka zawal barhta jata hai.

items: Parkinson's disease: dimagh ke dopamine banane wale neurons ka barhta hua marna ya kamzor hona, jis se harkat ke masail aur soch mein tabdeeli aati hai.
Huntington's disease: dimagh ke neurons ka barhta nuqsan, jis se harkat ki bimariyan, soch ka zawal aur nafsiyati alamaat aati hain.
Multiple sclerosis: CNS ki autoimmune bimari jo myelin sheath ko nuqsan deti hai, jis se nazar ka jana, dard, thakan aur kamzor tawazun hota hai.

blocks.caption: Alzheimer's disease
rows: dimagh ki barhti degenerative bimari jo yaad, soch aur rawayye ko mutasir karti hai; bare umar walon mein dementia (nasyan) ka sabab
jeeni, mahol aur tarz-e-zindagi ke asbab ka majmooa
halki bhool aur uljhan se shuru ho kar soch ki shadeed kharabi tak: zaban, masle hal karne aur jaane pehchane kaamon mein mushkil
koi ilaj nahi; dawayein is ki raftar kam aur yaad aur soch behtar kar sakti hain

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai Alzheimer's aam taur par bare umar walon mein shuru hota hai 'magar khaas taur par budhape se juda nahi'. Dar asal umar sab se bara maloom khatra hai, agarche yeh bimari budhape ka naarmal hissa nahi.

blocks.prompt: Parkinson's disease mein kaunsa neurotransmitter shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Dopamine: use banane wale neurons marte ya kamzor hote hain.

items: Degenerative: Parkinson's (dopamine neurons), Huntington's, multiple sclerosis (myelin, autoimmune), Alzheimer's (yaad, dementia; ilaj nahi).
